articles.title: 工信部加强智能体终端设备进网管理，规范终端与智能体适配
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，工信部今日发布关于加强智能体终端设备进网管理的通知，其中提到开展智能体和终端适配、改进智能体终端进网管理、强化智能体现网升级管理、健全智能体分发管理机制四大工作任务。IT之家整理四大工作任务如下：（一）开展智能体和终端适配。智能体是具备自主感知、记忆、决策、交互与执行能力的智能系统。智能体开发者应加强与终端设备的适配验证，强化权限调用、通信能力、网络与数据安全、用户权益和任务执行等方面管理，确保符合监管要求和用户预期，保障智能体兼容稳定运行。智能体开发者应规范智能体信息管理，在产品设置页面向用户公示适配验证列表，列明已完成适配的终端型号以及操作系统信息，保障用户知情权和选择权。智能体在应用分发平台上架前，其开发者应向应用分发平台提交适配验证情况。（二）改进智能体终端进网管理。开展风险评估，完善电信设备进网检测机制，细化特别规定事项要求。预置智能体的手机、平板、可穿戴设备等智能体终端，须在进网检测中依据有关标准开展智能体适配验证；依法开展智能体终端涉诈风险安全评估和反诈能力前置性评测，落实重要通信工作要求。终端上使用的智能体应参考智能体互联系列国家标准配备唯一身份码。终端生产企业应当保证智能体终端获得进网许可证前后的一致性。智能体终端发生重大变化的，终端生产企业应当向工业和信息化部报备，并按要求开展进网检测。（三）强化智能体现网升级管理。终端生产企业通过在线升级推送（OTA）等方式开展智能体现网升级的，应向工业和信息化部提交现网升级方案，明确现网升级时间、规模、用户群体、业务场景、服务内容、业务经营模式、网络和数据安全措施、反电信网络诈骗措施等内容，并同步做好重要通信工作。终端生产企业现网升级结束后，向工业和信息化部提交现网升级报告，经工业和信息化部组织专家评估、征求意见后方可正式向用户提供服务。（四）健全智能体分发管理机制。应用分发平台应推动应用程序开发者，通过电子签名主动声明是否同意智能体调用，未经声明同意的，智能体不得强制调用调取应用。应用分发平台应在分发页面向用户公示智能体适配验证列表，不得为用户提供不兼容设备型号的智能体下载和安装服务。应用分发平台应加强在架智能体适配验证情况巡查，对未完成适配验证的智能体应采取限期整改、下架处置等措施。

articles.title: 谷歌确认高通骁龙手机已支持安卓 Linux 终端，红魔 12 Pro 实测可用
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，9to5Google 发现，高通最新一代骁龙芯片已开始支持安卓系统内置的 Linux Terminal 应用，搭载骁龙 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 的红魔 12 Pro 确认可运行该功能，意味着此前长期缺席的骁龙平台终于加入 Android Linux Terminal 兼容阵营。公开报道显示，此前 Android Linux Terminal 主要应用于搭载 Tensor 芯片的 Pixel 手机，随后三星也为部分搭载 Exynos 芯片的 Galaxy 机型提供了相关支持，但骁龙平台一直未能进入兼容范围。简单来说，Android Linux Terminal 可通过 Android Virtualization Framework（AVF，Android 虚拟化框架）创建虚拟机，在手机上运行 Linux 系统。设备除了需要支持 AVF，还需要提供兼容的虚拟机环境。过去的部分骁龙芯片虽然具备一定的虚拟化能力，但并不满足该应用所需的条件，因此无法正常运行 Linux Terminal。此次兼容性变化与谷歌此前公布的底层架构支持计划有关。谷歌于 2026 年 10 月 7 日发布的官方安全博客文章中表示，联发科已宣布在天玑 9600 Pro 上支持基于 protected KVM（pKVM）的 Android On-device AI Seal 架构，高通骁龙芯片组也将通过 AVF 支持这一架构。不过，谷歌这项公告主要讨论的是设备端 AI 安全隔离架构，并未直接宣布骁龙手机全面支持 Linux Terminal。据 9to5Google 当地时间 11 月 4 日实测确认，搭载骁龙 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 的红魔 12 Pro 已经能够运行 Android Linux Terminal。这也是目前已知首款实现该功能的骁龙手机。9to5Google 介绍称，该机运行 Linux Terminal 时，默认分配 1GB 内存，用户可以手动将可用内存提高至 10.6GB。此外，用户还可以调整显示分辨率，并启用 Keep Awake（保持唤醒）功能。该机还支持 Linux 图形界面功能，理论上可以运行 GIMP 等 Linux 图形应用。不过，9to5Google 在测试过程中，尝试使用常规安装命令时遇到了 404 错误，因此部分软件的实际安装体验仍存在限制。存储空间方面，红魔 12 Pro 的 Linux Terminal 可用空间固定为 132GB，无法像部分其他设备一样调整虚拟机磁盘容量。相关阅读：《谷歌安卓 17 升级 Linux 终端：调整字体大小、切换控制台》《谷歌安卓 Canary 2603 增强 Linux 终端：可限制内存占用、设 24 小时常亮》《三星 Galaxy S26 Ultra 手机确认不支持安卓原生 Linux 终端》

articles.title: 全球海拔最高并网光热电站西藏阿里投运，实现昼夜连续供电
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据央视新闻报道，今天（11 月 6 日），位于西藏阿里地区的中广核“零碳”光储热电示范项目首台机组并网发电。这是全球海拔最高的并网光热电站，将进一步提升阿里地区清洁能源供应保障能力。IT之家从报道获悉，该项目位于西藏阿里地区噶尔县，平均海拔 4300 米，总装机容量 15 万千瓦，由 10 万千瓦光伏电站和 5 万千瓦光热电站组成。与普通光伏发电不同，这座光热电站能将白天光伏发出的电转化为热能储存起来，在夜间或光照不足时释放热量用于发电，实现昼夜连续供电。项目建设期间，累计带动当地 500 多名农牧民就业。全面建成投产后，预计年发电量约 2.7 亿千瓦时，每年可减排二氧化碳约 16.82 万吨，为阿里地区能源保供和绿色低碳发展提供支撑。延伸阅读光热发电与光伏发电的原理并不相同。光热发电是利用熔盐等介质吸收太阳光中的热能，再通过热交换产生蒸汽推动汽轮机发电；其关键优势在于可以把热能储存下来，在夜间或阴雨天继续发电，弥补光伏在夜间和阴雨天不能发电的缺口，并具备类似火电厂的调峰调频能力。塔式光热电站通常利用大规模自动跟踪太阳的定日镜场阵列，将太阳光精准反射到吸热塔顶部的吸热器上，加热内部的熔盐至约 540℃—560℃，再通过高温熔盐与水热交换产生高温高压蒸汽，驱动汽轮机发电。光热发电的主要技术路线包括塔式、槽式、菲涅尔式等。中广核阿里雪域高原“零碳”光储热电示范项目于 2022 年 9 月启动，总投资 27.8 亿元。项目建设内容包括 100 兆瓦光伏、100 兆瓦时电化学储能以及 50 兆瓦光热，是西藏地区首套“光伏＋熔盐电加热器＋异步互联储能”光热技术路线示范工程。其中 100 兆瓦光伏项目已于 2022 年底并网发电，此次并网的是 50 兆瓦光热部分。阿里地区曾长期面临缺电问题。2020 年 12 月，阿里与藏中电网联网工程建成投运，工程起于日喀则市桑珠孜区，止于阿里地区噶尔县，输电线路全长 1689 千米，塔位平均海拔 4572 米、最高海拔 5357 米，是世界海拔最高的超高压输变电工程之一。该工程结束了阿里电网孤网运行的历史，使沿线 16 个县、38 万农牧民的安全可靠用电问题得到解决和改善。从全国范围看，中国电力企业联合会数据显示，截至 2026 年 6 月底，我国已建成投运光热发电项目 24 个，装机容量达 210 万千瓦，位居全球第二，在建项目 26 个、装机容量 320 万千瓦。2025 年 12 月，国家发展改革委、国家能源局发布的《关于促进光热发电规模化发展的若干意见》提出，到 2030 年光热发电总装机规模力争达到 1500 万千瓦左右。

articles.title: 终于告别 3.5 英寸软盘：美国计划 2028 年前替换 435 个空管设施老旧系统
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）昨日（11 月 5 日）宣布，正式启动空中交通管制信息系统现代化升级工程，逐步淘汰仍在全美 400 多个设施中使用的 3.5 英寸软盘及相关老旧设备。美国交通部长肖恩 · 达菲（Sean P. Duffy）表示，新的企业信息显示系统（E-IDS）将取代可追溯至上世纪 80 年代的 4 套旧系统，让管制员更快获取天气、设备故障、空域限制和飞行员报告等关键运行信息。以上图源：视频截图E-IDS 是一种统一的数字化信息显示平台，可集中呈现设备异常、交通状况、天气影响、航行通告（NOTAM）及飞行员天气报告（PIREP），减少人工插拔软盘、逐站更新信息的低效流程。FAA 称，该系统还将提升信息跨设施共享能力，降低维护成本，并增强网络安全与运行韧性。美国联邦航空管理局表示首批升级覆盖 5 个地点，分别为大西洋城国际机场、纳什维尔国际机场、罗切斯特国际机场，以及亚特兰大和盐湖城的数据处理中心。按照计划，美国联邦航空管理局将在 2028 年底前把 E-IDS 部署至全国 435 个空管设施。软盘早已淡出大众消费市场，大规模生产也在 2011 年前后基本停止；但美国空管系统长期依赖这类介质传递关键信息，成为基础设施老化的标志性例证。美国国会去年已批准 125 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 835.32 亿元人民币）用于改造老旧空管体系，达菲还在推动追加 300 亿美元（现汇率约合 2,004.76 亿元人民币）投资。

articles.title: 第二艘国产大型邮轮“爱达 · 花城号”正式交付，较原计划提前约两个月
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据央视新闻报道，第二艘国产大型邮轮“爱达 · 花城号”今日在上海外高桥造船有限公司正式交付。该船由爱达邮轮运营，交付后将于 11 月 7 日从外高桥造船厂移泊至上海吴淞口国际邮轮港，随后开展试运营航次，11 月 12 日抵达广州南沙国际邮轮母港，11 月 22 日从广州开启首航季。这是继“爱达 · 魔都号”之后，国产大型邮轮完成的第二次交付，标志着该型船舶从单船突破进入系列化建造阶段。从“魔都号”到“花城号”，国产大型邮轮的建造节奏正在加快，第二艘船的交付时间较原计划提前了约两个月。“爱达 · 花城号”全长 341 米，型宽 37.2 米，总吨位 14.19 万吨，全船纵向划分 16 层游客活动区域，共设 2130 间客房，最大载客量 5232 人。与首艘国产大型邮轮“爱达 · 魔都号”相比，该船长度增加 17.4 米，总吨位增加 0.64 万吨，公共区域和户外活动休闲区域面积分别增加 735 平方米和 1913 平方米，达到 25599 平方米和 14272 平方米。在技术配置上，该船较首艘新增了两套脱硫塔和选择性催化还原系统，用于控制船舶排放。在客舱体验方面，全船客房经过降噪减震处理，官方数据显示船舶在最大航行工况下室内噪声控制在 45 分贝以内。船上配置 28 间餐厅及酒吧、800 人容量剧院和 200 米环形海上跑道，并针对华南市场引入粤语服务、粤菜及广府早茶等本地化内容。IT之家注意到，它交付后的运营安排已经明确。11 月 22 日的首航航次为 6 天 5 晚，目的地为中国香港和越南顺化（真美），奥运跳水冠军郭晶晶担任启航大使并在首航仪式上为邮轮命名。首航季之后，“爱达 · 花城号”还计划推出 9 天 8 晚的“南洋风情线”、香港跨年航次，以及 17 天 16 晚的东南亚六国“海丝发现之旅”。

articles.title: 我国高端镀膜装备实现自主突破，新景昇首台 8.5 代电致变色薄膜设备下线
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据北京亦庄公众号，近日，北京新景昇智联科技有限公司（以下简称“新景昇”）8.5 代电致变色薄膜产线完成重大攻关节点验收并成功下线首台设备，标志着我国大面积连续磁控溅射镀膜核心装备实现重大突破，补齐产业链上游关键短板。IT之家从官方介绍获悉，电致变色薄膜是一种可通过电压可逆调节光学状态的功能薄膜，可应用于建筑节能、交通调光以及集成电路与光电器件等领域。8.5 代产线的难点在于大尺寸基板上多层薄膜的均匀性和连续量产稳定性，而此类高端镀膜装备长期依赖进口。据悉，历经八年攻关，新景昇自研的 8.5 代电致变色薄膜设备可实现超大基板多层薄膜连续制备，膜厚均匀性控制在 2% 以内。接下来，该设备将运往哈尔滨景烁智能科技有限公司开展工艺验证，支撑全固态电致变色薄膜产业化落地。北京经开区集成电路领域目前已形成覆盖设计、制造、封测、装备、材料、零部件等环节的完整产业链。今年 1 至 9 月，经开区实现集成电路产业产值 1667 亿元，同比增长 100%。延伸阅读所谓“8.5 代”指的是玻璃基板的世代规格，第 8.5 代玻璃基板尺寸为 2200 毫米 × 2500 毫米，世代越高代表可加工的基板尺寸越大。该设备所采用的大面积连续磁控溅射工艺属于物理气相沉积（PVD）的一种，是在真空环境下使靶材原子沉积到基板表面从而生长出薄膜的制备方法。电致变色薄膜的工作原理是：在小电压（约 1.2 至 3V）驱动下，锂离子在电致变色层与反向电致变色层之间移动，分别与两个变色层发生稳定可逆的氧化及还原反应，从而调节玻璃的反射率、透光率和吸收率等，控制进入室内的光线与热量。新景昇是北京经开区重点引进培育的半导体装备标杆企业，专注于大面积镀膜技术及成套设备的研发制造，主营 EC（电致变色）玻璃相关技术与产品开发。全固态无机电致变色薄膜可应用于建筑幕墙、汽车后视镜、新能源车天幕玻璃、AR / VR 眼镜等领域，实现玻璃透光度的自主调节。

articles.title: Anthropic 推出 Claude 个人理财功能，支持消费分析和账单追踪
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，当地时间 11 月 5 日，Anthropic 宣布为 Claude 加入个人理财功能，本周开启灰度测试，面向美国地区的 Pro、Max 以及 Ultra 订阅用户开放。据官方介绍，想要理清自己的财务状况，用户再也不用挨个打开银行 App，自己动手算账了。借助 Claude 个人财务功能，用户可以安全绑定银行卡账户，用自然语言直接提问。该功能仅拥有只读权限，Claude 个人财务功能无法划转、管理用户的资金，也不能替用户做投资。Claude 会用通俗直白的语言为用户解答，支持查看余额、交易记录，遇到陌生术语还会给出解释。和 Claude 本身的定位一样，个人财务板块没有广告，也不会推送赞助推荐；Claude 本身不发行信用卡、不提供贷款，也没有自营储蓄账户，因此用户得到的财务答案都是客观直接的。IT之家注意到，假设已经到月底，距离发薪日还有 10 天。用户向 Claude 提问：“我这个月钱都花去哪了？”它会汇总你所有已绑定账户的支出，并按类别分类统计。如果用户问有没有异常账单，Claude 会遍历其绑定的全部账户，帮用户留意容易忽略的问题，比如重复扣费、莫名手续费，或是一整年悄悄涨价的账单。用户也可以提出更宏观的问题，例如“我的支出是不是已经超过收入？”或者“什么是年利率（APR），今年它让我花了多少利息？”Claude 会先解释术语，再帮用户统计产生的利息总额。此外，用户还可以要求生成每周支出图表、待缴账单日历，或是自定义数据看板，Claude 生成后，也可以随时调整。Anthropic 强调，Claude 仅拥有只读权限。个人财务功能仅用于帮你看懂自己的资金情况，并不提供投资建议。Claude 给出的结果有可能出错，你可以要求它列出对应数据背后的交易明细，重要金额请务必和银行核对。

articles.title: BLG 零封 DK 挺进《英雄联盟》S16 四强，下轮对战 T1/KC 胜者
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，2026 全球总决赛淘汰赛 1/4 决赛第三日的比赛火热进行中，来自 LPL 赛区的二号种子 BLG 以 3:0 战胜了 LCK 四号种子 DK 战队，晋级 2026 全球总决赛半决赛！明天，LCK 三号种子 T1 战队将与 LEC 三号种子 KC 进行角逐，其中的胜者将在接下来的 11 月 9 日与 BLG 争夺总决赛名额。IT之家届时将为大家带来详细报道。在 S16 全球总决赛八强赛 BLG 对阵 DK 的第二局比赛中，BLG 上单选手 Bin 正式达成国际赛事 200 次出场里程碑，成为首位达成这一成就的上单选手。根据赛前统计，Bin 以 198 次出场、63.6% 的胜率位居国际赛事上单出场次数榜首。排在其后的分别是 Zeus（169 场）、Impact（167 场）、BrokenBlade（145 场）和 Doran（134 场）。DK 在本次 S16 的旅程：DK 作为 LCK 赛区四号种子，在瑞士轮前两轮先后击败 LEC 赛区一号种子 G2 和同赛区三号种子 T1，第三轮 BO3 以 2-0 击败 LEC 赛区二号种子 MKOI，以 3 胜 0 负的战绩成功晋级八强。八强赛，DK 0-3 不敌 BLG，止步八强。第一局赛事简介：【BLG 1:0 DK】本局 MVP 给到 BLG 战队打野选手 Xun【本局比赛战报】3 分钟，双方打野支援下路，Lucid 奇亚娜击败卡西奥佩娅拿到一血，但随后 Viper 卡西奥佩娅极限换掉库奇，双方一换一；25 分钟，下路发生团战，ON 诺提勒斯果断开团，Xun 纳亚菲利三杀，BLG 打出二换四；29 分钟，下路再次爆发团战，Knight 加里奥控制拉满主宰战场，Xun 纳亚菲利再次三杀，BLG 三换四并顺势拿下远古巨龙和大龙；32 分钟，BLG 进攻 DK 高地，BLG 推进坚决，Knight 加里奥双杀，BLG 击败 DK 三人并推平基地拿下胜利。第二局赛事简介：【BLG 2:0 DK】本局 MVP 给到 BLG 战队下路选手 Viper【本局比赛战报】3 分钟，下路对拼中，Viper 伊泽瑞尔极限操作击败芸阿娜拿下一血，随后 Career 璐璐击败伊泽瑞尔，双方一换一；9 分钟，河道发生团战，BLG 出色应对 DK 开团，Viper 伊泽瑞尔双杀，BLG 打出二换三；22 分钟，双方再次在河道进行团战，ON 蕾欧娜果断开团，Viper 伊泽瑞尔持续输出，双方二换二，BLG 拿下龙魂；31 分钟，双方争夺远古巨龙，Xun 李青拿下远古巨龙，BLG 一换二并随后推平 DK 基地拿下胜利。第三局赛事简介：【BLG 3:0 DK】本局 MVP 给到 BLG 战队上路选手 Bin【本局比赛战报】开局，BLG 中野在野区成功蹲伏，Xun 特朗德尔击败维克托，拿到一血；18 分钟，双方争夺小龙，Bin 贾克斯持续输出拿下双杀，BLG 拿下小龙并击败 DK 三人；23 分钟，双方争夺小龙，BLG 追击果断，Bin 贾克斯完成收割拿下三杀，BLG 一换四并拿下大龙；32 分钟，BLG 进攻 DK 高地，Knight 阿狸果断大招进场开团，BLG 团灭 DK 并推平基地赢下比赛。相关阅读：《BLG 2:0 HLE：英雄联盟 S16 全球总决赛 8 强诞生，LPL 赛区三支队伍晋级》《〈英雄联盟〉S16 淘汰赛首日：iG 3:1 战胜 TES 晋级，时隔 7 年重回四强舞台》《〈英雄联盟〉S16 淘汰赛第二日：GEN 3:0 战胜 LYON 晋级，半决赛对阵 iG》

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，11 月 5 日，在 2026 年 CeMAT ASIA 亚洲国际物流技术与运输系统展览会上，京东物流携全新升级的“狼族”机器人亮相，推出“智狼”“保姆狼”全新升级方案。“狼族”是京东物流自研的具身机器人军团，覆盖仓储、分拣、运输、配送全链路。其包含“智狼”“保姆狼”“异狼”“飞狼”等 9 款产品、11 款机器人，在“超脑”大模型调度下协同作业。其中，“智狼”和“保姆狼”处在仓储拣选与分播两个关键节点，已在全球规模化部署，在本次展会全新升级亮相。IT之家从官方介绍获悉，“智狼”是货到人解决方案，解决传统仓库存储密度不足及“人找货”效率低的问题。“智狼”飞梯机器人从 12 米高的货架取箱，再由“智狼”搬运机器人送至拣选站，人只需在站内拣选，不用在货架间穿行。该方案已在全球超 100 个仓库规模化落地，存储效率较传统提升 600%，出库效率提升 300%。此次“智狼”升级，集中在结构创新与供电方式。京东物流首创“旋转式取货平台”，简化“先钩取再传送”的取放货步骤，实现一次钩取到位，单台设备每小时作业次数可突破 240 次，相当于每 15 秒完成一次取货，动作效率进一步提升 30%；旋转式平台突破性采用双深位存储方案，存储能力提升 20%。此外，升级版“智狼”采用无线供电，取消了物理接触，避免滑触线磨损，实现供电系统零维护，即使-20℃ 低温环境仍可正常使用。“保姆狼”是分拣端到端自动化解决方案，整合投递、分播、取货和打包等作业步骤，可将不同类型商品，按订单地址快速归类分配，用于订单分拣、退货分类等场景，在 SKU 种类繁多的电商、服装、图书、美妆等行业实现规模化应用。此次“保姆狼”升级的核心，是打通从机器人投递、自动分播、自动取换箱到自动打包的端到端全无人化，整条链路不再依赖人工翻包、搬箱和打包。最大亮点是搭载双臂具身机器人，可识别包裹并自动翻包、投递，使面单朝上，替代纯人工作业；其次，行业首创自动取换货技术，替代人工取换，最高 180 次 / 小时自动取箱、换货，兼容多种箱型；此外，首创上下双层独立运行供包台，搭配双臂具身机器人实现更好人机协同，最高支持每小时 34560 件以上商品分播。

articles.title: OpenSSH 紧急修复 Alpine Linux 严重漏洞：超 256 字节密码即可突破 SSH 防线
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，科技媒体 The Hacker News 最新报道称 OpenSSH 项目昨日（11 月 5 日）发布紧急更新 10.6p2，紧急修复一个允许用 257 至 1,024 字节长密码绕过 SSH 认证的漏洞。报道指出攻击者若能访问目标服务器的 SSH 端口，无需真实密码，只需知道一个未设置密码的账户名，并提交一段 257 至 1,024 字节的长密码，即可成功登录该账户。IT之家附上相关图片如下：在触发条件方面，该媒体指出仅限特定场景：服务器需运行未启用 PAM 的 openssh-server，开启密码登录，存在密码字段为 * 的无密码账户，且系统中至少还有一个使用 $5$ 或 $6$ 哈希的已设密码账户。而 Alpine Linux 默认构建的 OpenSSH 恰好符合前两项条件，因此风险不容忽视。漏洞根源在于 sshd 与 musl 库的 crypt() 函数交互。当无密码账户的存储字段过短、无法提供盐值时，sshd 会借用其他账户的盐值；而 musl 对超过 256 字节的密码返回 *，恰好与无密码账户的存储值匹配，导致登录被错误放行。OpenSSH 项目称该问题自 2016 年起即可能存在。受影响的不只 Alpine。安全研究人员指出，OpenWrt、Buildroot 和 Yocto 等基于 musl 的系统也需排查；不过 OpenWrt 默认使用的 Dropbear 不受影响，仅当管理员另行安装 OpenSSH 服务器时才可能暴露。Alpine 已为 3.16 至 3.24 等多个版本发布修复包，3.21.10、3.22.8、3.23.8 和 3.24.4 等点版本也已包含修复。管理员应执行 apk upgrade -U -a 更新软件包，并重启 sshd 服务；若暂无法升级，应立即将 PasswordAuthentication 设为 no，改用 SSH 密钥登录。OpenSSH 提醒，若日志中出现针对 root、alpine 或仅密钥账户的“Accepted password”记录，且无法排除异常登录，应将该主机视为已被入侵，并检查 doas 使用记录、新建用户、文件变动和授权密钥。目前尚无利用该漏洞的攻击报告，也暂未分配 CVE 编号。

articles.title: 美股科技股遭遇大幅抛售：马斯克、黄仁勋等五大富豪单日财富缩水 1529 亿美元，费城半导体指数跌约 12% 为历史第二大单日跌幅
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，美国中期选举结束后，美股 11 月 5 日遭遇大规模抛售，科技股和 AI 硬件产业链成为主要下跌板块。福布斯实时亿万富豪排行榜数据显示，埃隆・马斯克单日身价减少 912 亿美元，戴尔科技创始人迈克尔・戴尔、英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋、甲骨文创始人拉里・埃里森和 Meta 创始人马克・扎克伯格也出现大幅财富缩水，五人身价合计减少 1,529 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.02 万亿元人民币）。据路透社 11 月 5 日报道，投资者重新评估美国中期选举结果对 AI 数据中心建设的影响，担忧民主党在国会取得优势后可能放缓数据中心扩张，科技股和半导体股票因此遭遇集中抛售。路透社指出，费城半导体指数当天跌幅达到约 12%，创下历史第二大单日跌幅。美股三大指数均大幅收跌。美联社数据显示，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌 3.4%，标普 500 指数下跌 4.4%，纳斯达克综合指数下跌 5.5%。纳指较近期高点回落 11.9%，进入技术性回调区间。个股方面，英伟达下跌 9.3%，AMD 下跌 17.3%，戴尔科技下跌约 15%，特斯拉下跌约 10.8%。彭博社报道称，特斯拉和 SpaceX 当天均遭遇约 11% 的盘中跌幅，AI 芯片及数据中心相关股票成为市场抛售的重灾区。福布斯实时亿万富豪排行榜数据显示，全球五位科技富豪的身价单日缩水情况如下：埃隆・马斯克：减少 912 亿美元，跌幅 10.50%。迈克尔・戴尔：减少 205 亿美元，跌幅 9.60%。黄仁勋：减少 151 亿美元，跌幅 8.70%。拉里・埃里森：减少 132 亿美元，跌幅 8.05%。马克・扎克伯格：减少 129 亿美元，跌幅 5.98%。五人身价合计减少 1529 亿美元，其中马斯克一人的财富缩水额约占总额的 59.6%。

articles.title: Hugging Face CEO 称 AI“末日风险”接近于零，真正危险来自闭门造车
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，当地时间昨日（11 月 5 日）在美国迈阿密举行的 WIRED 世界博览会上，开源 AI 平台 Hugging Face 首席执行官克莱门特 · 德朗格（Clément Delangue）表示，他对人工智能导致人类灭绝的概率（即 P (Doom)）评估“接近于零”。他认为，相比“AI 毁灭世界”的宏大担忧，更现实的风险是少数大公司在封闭环境中秘密开发前沿模型。德朗格称，AI 的主要风险并非来自开放生态，而是“少数闭门造车的参与者”。他主张，降低风险的关键是让更多开发者能够公开构建、审查和改进模型，从而形成相互制衡的生态系统。在他看来，开放权重模型不仅是技术选择，也是防止少数企业垄断人才、算力与 AI 能力的手段。德朗格还透露，Hugging Face 目前的 AI 开发者已超过 2,000 万，较英伟达今年 9 月宣布以 129.3 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 864.42 亿元人民币）收购该公司时公布的约 1,800 万用户继续增长。该公司还已售出 5 万台可通过 AI 编程的双足机器人 Microducks。

articles.title: 全球超 320 万青少年洞察：2025 年 24.9% 过去一周每天中高强度运动不足 60 分钟
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，世界卫生组织本周三（11 月 4 日）发布研究报告，指出全球约 2.4 亿的 11 至 17 岁青少年在过去一周，每天的中高强度身体活动均不足 60 分钟。这项发表于《柳叶刀-全球健康》的研究，汇集了 140 个国家和地区的 389 项人群调查，涉及超过 320 万名青少年。受访者平均每周仅有 2.7 天的身体活动达到上述时长，只有 14% 表示一周七天都能达到。世卫组织总干事谭德塞表示，过去 15 年里，全球在促进青少年身体活动方面几乎没有进展，女孩的处境尤其令人担忧。他强调，改善这一状况不能只靠要求青少年更加努力，还需要让学校、街道和社区成为能够安全、便利开展日常活动的场所。研究发现，青少年身体活动的性别差距长期存在。28% 的女孩表示，过去一周没有任何一天进行至少 60 分钟的中高强度身体活动，男孩的这一比例为 22%。一周七天都达到上述时长的女孩仅占 11%，男孩为 17%。在几乎所有受调查国家以及世卫组织各区域，女孩的身体活动水平都低于男孩。世卫组织指出，身体活动不足是心脏病、2 型糖尿病和部分癌症的重要风险因素。帮助青少年尽早养成积极活动的习惯，对保护健康、减轻这些疾病的全球负担至关重要。而青少年活动不足并非单一原因所致。居住和学习环境、交通方式、公共空间的安全性、步行和骑行条件、活动费用、社会观念，以及日益依赖屏幕的生活方式，都会影响他们参与身体活动的机会。IT之家附上参考地址A generation missing out: global trends in adolescent physical activity, 2010–2025全球四分之一青少年过去一周每天运动均不足一小时

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，蚂蚁百灵官方团队今日宣布推出原生多模态模型 Ling-3.2-flash，拥有 560B 总参数、25B 激活参数、1M 上下文窗口。该模型从架构层面原生融合视觉与语言能力，支持图像、文本与视频输入，重点强化复杂视觉理解、多模态长程 Agent、3D 理解与交互、医疗多模态四大能力。在蚂蚁官方公布的评测结果中，Ling-3.2-flash 在三项基准上超过 Anthropic Claude Opus 5（max）：OmniDocBench1.5 得分 92.21，对比 90.56；ZEROBench（Sub）得分 43.71，对比 39.52；Vision2Web 得分 85.86，对比 80.20。在 DesignArena 图像转前端竞技场中，该模型以 1238 的 Elo 分数进入前十，与 Meta、DeepSeek 及 Anthropic 等竞品并列。该模型重点强化四大能力：复杂视觉理解面向图像与视频的深度推理与分析；多模态长程 Agent 要求在多步任务中持续保持目标一致，基于视觉与文本信息完成决策与执行；3D 理解与交互侧重三维场景与空间关系的解析；医疗多模态则覆盖医学影像理解与报告解读，辅助专业医疗分析。据介绍，560B 总参数与约 25B 激活参数的组合，是 Ling-3.2-flash 在能力与推理开销之间的核心权衡。这种模式通常对应混合专家（MoE）架构，模型在每次前向计算中仅调用部分参数，从而在保留大容量知识存储的同时控制单步计算成本。定价方面，Ling-3.2-flash 的 API 输入价格为每百万词元 0.30 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 2 元人民币），输出价格为每百万词元 0.90 美元（现汇率约合 6 元人民币），DesignArena 榜单指出这是同性能级别模型中最低的费率。其 API 已通过蚂蚁百炼平台上线，感兴趣的用户可通过对话页在线体验，并兼容 OpenAI 及 Anthropic 协议进行 API 调用，而且上线前 2 周限时免费体验。

articles.title: 微软 Office 365 A1 退役：2028 年起取消 100TB 教育版基础存储，免费 A0 学生版不含 Teams 与邮箱
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，微软宣布调整 Microsoft 365 Education 教育版授权政策，将逐步停用免费 Office 365 A1、Student Use Benefit（学生使用权益）等项目，并计划从 2028 年 1 月 1 日起取消教育机构现有的 100TB 基础共享云存储额度。微软此次调整涉及教育版产品授权、校友邮箱、云存储分配及订阅价格等多个方面。相关变化将分阶段实施，学校和高校现有授权不会立即失效，但需要在后续合同续约时调整授权方案。微软首先宣布将停止销售 Office 365 A1。该方案已于 2026 年 11 月 5 日停止通过 Web Direct 渠道销售，Cloud Solution Provider（CSP，云解决方案提供商）及批量许可渠道则计划从 2027 年 5 月 1 日起停止销售，最终退役日期为 2028 年 1 月 1 日。对于现有用户，2027 年 5 月 1 日之前开始的有效 Enrollment（注册协议）所涵盖的机构，可以在当前协议期限内继续使用已有授权。但在 2028 年 1 月 1 日或之后进入续约或到期阶段后，相关授权将无法继续续订或延期，学校需要为受影响用户更换其他授权方案。同样计划于 2028 年 1 月 1 日退役的还有 Student Use Benefit 项目。该项目将从包括 CSP 和批量许可在内的所有教育采购计划中取消。现有授权在当前订阅期限内仍然有效，但退役后无法续订，学校需要重新确认仍需使用相关服务的学生，并为他们配置适当的付费学生授权。微软还将停止免费的 Exchange Online for Alumni 校友邮箱服务。希望继续为毕业生提供邮箱服务的教育机构，需要转向新的付费校友邮箱方案。该付费方案预计于 2028 年 1 月 1 日通过 CSP 和 Enrollment for Education Solutions（EES）渠道推出。此外，Open Value Subscription for Education Solutions（OVS-ES）和 School 3 也计划在同一天退役。此次调整中，另一项重要变化是微软将取消教育版租户原有的 100TB 免费基础共享存储额度。根据微软公布的新政策，从 2028 年 1 月 1 日起，教育机构首次进行合同续约或延期时，将不再自动获得这 100TB 基础容量。此前，微软为教育版租户提供覆盖 OneDrive、SharePoint Online 和 Exchange Online 的共享存储池，三项服务共同使用这一额度。微软官方文档也明确说明，原有存储池由 100TB 初始免费额度、付费授权贡献的存储空间以及额外购买的存储空间组成。新政策实施后，存储容量将主要根据授权类型和数量计算。学生授权方面，Microsoft 365 Education A2 每个授权贡献 4GB，A3 贡献 8GB，A5 和 A7 均贡献 12GB。教职员工授权方面，A2 每个贡献 50GB，A3 贡献 75GB，A5 和 A7 均贡献 150GB。新推出的免费 A0 学生授权不会为机构增加额外存储空间，其用户使用的存储容量将从学校现有共享存储池中扣除。微软建议学校管理员在合同续约前，评估现有存储使用量及未来需求，并结合用户数量、授权组合和预计可获得的存储容量制定方案。如果存储空间不足，机构可以每次购买 10TB 的额外存储包、升级至存储贡献更高的授权方案、清理现有数据，或者使用 Microsoft 365 Archive 归档不活跃内容。随着 Office 365 A1 退役，微软还将推出全新的 Microsoft 365 Education 授权体系，包含 A0、A2、A3、A5 和 A7 五个等级。各等级将分别提供学生版和教职员工版，并提供包含 Teams 和不包含 Teams 的不同版本，以便学校根据不同用户的实际需求分配授权。其中，A0 是一项面向符合条件学生的免费方案，包含 Office 桌面版和网页版应用、Minecraft Education、Microsoft Entra ID Free，以及 Learning Zone 学习体验。不过，学校必须为全部教职员工提供 Microsoft 365 Education A2 或更高级别的付费授权，学生还必须积极使用 Windows 设备开展教育活动。A0 不包含 Exchange Online、SharePoint Online 和 Teams。位于新授权体系顶端的是 Microsoft 365 Education A7。IT之家注意到，该方案在 A5 基础上增加了高级 AI、身份管理、安全防护、治理及设备管理功能，并包含 Microsoft 36

articles.title: 联发科组建“封装梦之队”：招募 37 年经验前英特尔老将，双线布局 AI 芯片 CoWoS+EMIB 战略
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，集邦咨询（TrendForce）今天（11 月 6 日）发布博文，报道称前英特尔高管纳维德 · 沙赫里亚里（Navid Shahriari）将于 11 月 9 日加入联发科，出任高级副总裁，直接向公司总裁兼首席运营官汇报。IT之家援引博文介绍，沙赫里亚里拥有 37 年半导体设计工程与先进封装经验，并长期深耕数据中心市场。在加入联发科后，他将统筹先进工艺与良率平台、设计技术协同优化、先进测试与封装，以及质量与可靠性等关键环节。报道指出他的核心任务之一，是深化与台积电及其他供应链伙伴的合作，推动先进技术整合，强化联发科在 AI 和高性能计算领域的产品能力。沙赫里亚里在英特尔任职多年，曾担任执行副总裁，负责封装测试、代工技术与制造运营，并主导复杂封装、基板技术以及全球大型制造基地的生产支持。他的经验覆盖嵌入式芯片封装、测试验证、数据中心产品组合，以及 CPU、GPU / NPU 相关知识产权和生态建设。市场层面，联发科据称正与英特尔就 EMIB（嵌入式多芯片互连桥）技术展开合作，应用于部分云 ASIC 项目，其中可能包括与谷歌 TPU 相关的工作。同时，联发科也支持台积电 CoWoS 技术，形成“CoWoS+EMIB”双路线封装策略，让客户可按需求选择方案。该机构解读认为 AI ASIC 正成为联发科的新增长引擎。该公司首款 AI 加速器 ASIC 已于 2026 年 9 月开始出货，预计第四季度带来约 25 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 167.14 亿元人民币）营收；联发科还瞄准 2027 年实现约 160 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,069.67 亿元人民币） AI ASIC 营收、约 20% 市场份额，下一代产品计划于 2028 年第一季度量产。集邦咨询认为这并非联发科首次从封装领域引进重量级人才。联发科已于 2026 年 5 月聘请台积电前研发副总裁余振华（Douglas Yu）担任兼职顾问，协助先进封装研发与路线图规划。两笔人事布局，显示出联发科正把先进封装视为进军 AI ASIC 市场的重要支点。

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，当地时间 11 月 5 日，G2 Esports 宣布与《英雄联盟》分部主教练卢卡 ·“Perkz”· 佩尔科维奇（Luka “Perkz” Perković）结束合作，此时距后者发布那篇引发巨大争议的长文仅过去数小时。前一天，Perkz 于 11 月 4 日在 X 上发布一篇 2676 词的长文（截至IT之家发稿，Perkz 已删号），谈及宗教信仰、政治立场、堕胎及过往争议言论，在玩家和粉丝群体中引发剧烈争议。Perkz 将这篇长文称为自己“过去十年来第一次、也是最后一次坦诚发言”，表示希望借此澄清外界对其个人立场的误解。在声明中，他表示自己不喜欢也不支持 Andrew Tate 和 Tristan Tate 兄弟，称自己并不热衷政治，过去从未投过票。他还表示，自己既不支持美国总统唐纳德・特朗普，也不支持卡玛拉・哈里斯，并称自己是一名虔诚的天主教徒。针对俄乌战争相关争议，他否认自己是俄罗斯总统普京的支持者，也否认站在俄罗斯一方。真正引爆舆论的点，是他以天主教信仰为由对堕胎的立场。Perkz 称“我无法理解人们为何不明白那是谋杀，因为生命在受孕时就已存在。这是我会至死坚持、永不改变的观点”。在长文中，他还解释了自己曾公开为 G2 前 CEO、已退役《英雄联盟》职业选手卡洛斯 ·“ocelote”· 罗德里格斯（Carlos “ocelote” Rodríguez Santiago）辩护的原因。后者于 2022 年因在社交媒体分享自己与 Andrew Tate 同场参加派对的视频而引发争议，随后辞去 G2 职务。Perkz 表示，自己当年公开支持卡洛斯并不意味着认同人口贩卖、厌女、纳粹主义或战争等行为。他还回忆称，自己 16 岁时与家人的关系并不亲近，而卡洛斯愿意相信他。不过，Perkz 同时表示，两人如今已经走上不同道路，在生活观念上存在许多分歧。相关言论发布后，堕胎问题成为社交平台上讨论的焦点，不少《英雄联盟》玩家及粉丝对其表态提出批评。G2 Esports 随后发布公开声明，宣布终止与 Perkz 的合作。G2 CEO 阿尔班 · 德谢洛特（Alban Dechelotte）在声明中表示，俱乐部是一家拥有不同国家和文化背景成员的国际化组织，尊重并维护粉丝群体的多样性十分重要。他指出，佩尔科维奇部分言论与 G2 的立场和价值观不符，俱乐部也意识到这些言论伤害了许多粉丝，并对此表示歉意。G2 在声明中确认，已经决定终止与相关人员的合作，接下来将着手重建下赛季的工作人员团队和阵容。俱乐部同时请求粉丝给予耐心，并表示在转会期正式开放之前，暂时无法公布人员调整情况。公开报道显示，Perkz 在 2026 赛季初接替迪伦 · 法尔科（Dylan Falco）出任 G2 主教练，此前他已在 G2 担任位置教练。执教期间，他率队夺得 LEC 2026 夏季赛冠军，这是 G2 队史第 20 座联赛冠军，也是他首次以教练身份夺冠，队伍随后在 MSI 2026 进入四强，但在 2026 年全球总决赛中于瑞士轮阶段出局。Perkz 在长文中形容自己接手时 G2 是一支“破碎且功能失调、带着许多创伤和信任问题”的队伍，并称自己每天与选手共处 12 至 14 小时，承认“可能没有做到完美，但已经尽了全力”。被 G2 解约的消息公布后，Perkz 又在 X 上发布了另一条推文，引用了《圣经》路加福音 6 章 22 节的经文：“人为人子恨恶你们，拒绝你们，辱骂你们，弃掉你们的名，以为是恶，你们就有福了。”该帖同样招致批评，此后他未再发布新内容，截至目前其 X 账号已经显示为不存在状态。

articles.title: Show HN: Open-world text adventure played through AI agents
articles.content: Hey HN,I am building Eremoterra, this experiment of trying to make a game out of an MCP (to learn MCP stuff, but also had a lot fun designing the game).You play in your own agent. The server returns a fact sheet for the place you are. The world is like real Earth, but empty (until the players start to arrive) and only the natural wold (as humanity never existed).The agent narrates the sheet and can write what you confirm in a sort of lore book, typed events and fixed templates, so the model cannot become the source of truth. I added some NPCs that, i hope, bring some interesting emergent behaviour. Within the game there are also "journeys", which is more like traditional text adventures of trying to find something and bringing it home.The world is one Rust process and one RocksDB. The Earth is 233,280,000 parcels of one arcminute. Geography is a memory-mapped atlas of about 1.9 GB, built from public natural-state data. articles.title: Ask HN: In the age of agentic AI, do you still pair program?
articles.content:
What about mob/ensemble programming? I work on a team that used to use mob programming heavily. There would be a driver and a navigator, and then someone taking notes. Other people would be "muses" or observers. Always occurring over Zoom. I always felt like this was a very draining way of programming. Pair programming felt a bit better. Of course, we still get together to discuss architecture or how we want to go about a certain set of work or if we're blocked, but with agents, it just doesn't make sense to get everybody in a call to watch someone else's agent work.So, in the age of agentic AI, how do these two concepts evolve (or disappear)?

articles.title: 91% ≈ 0%？谷歌最新研究，戳破工程 Agent 的高正确率泡沫
articles.content: 41.3% 的设计项跨过安全门槛，复杂工程仍困于约束耦合。    作者丨郑佳美 岑   峰    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       在工程世界里，91% 的正确，有时和 0% 的交付能力没有区别。一条电缆桥架在机房顶部穿过消防管线，就能让几十页正确的计算书失去交付价值。载流量算对了，电压降符合要求，设备选型也有依据，但进入三维空间后，几套系统争夺同一段净空，工程师只能退回方案。AI Agent 能快速完成局部计算，工程项目却不会按计算题的边界运转：一处调整牵动另一处，刚核验过的结果也可能随修订失效。Google 与 Mercor 近日发布的 Physical-Engineering's Last Exam（PLE），以 85 项机械、电气、土木与结构工程任务量化了这种落差。在 56 项隐藏测试中，Claude Opus 5.5 搭配 Claude Code 得分 48.3%，而在共同创作任务中，它平均满足 91% 的单项约束，只有 41.3% 的交付设计项满足全部硬性安全与可行性要求。更棘手的是，剩下的 9% 往往无法靠继续提高模型的计算能力解决。因为工程设计中的要求彼此关联，解决一个问题，可能又会产生新的问题。PLE 的技术设计恰好揭示了这一困境：当局部能力已经足够强，工程 Agent 究竟还缺少什么？01工程 Agent 正在遭遇可行域瓶颈此前很多 Agent 评测采用逐项累积分数的方式，只要完成更多要求，就能取得更高评价。这适合衡量知识理解和单点执行能力，却会掩盖工程设计中的一类关键失败：模型可能满足了绝大多数要求，但剩下一条恰好决定方案能否投入使用。PLE 在 41 项人机共同创作任务中，将工程约束与设计优化放进同一套评价体系。其中 37 项采用约束评分，在统一评分机制下，40% 的评分空间取决于单项检查通过比例，另外 60% 则与成本或性能优化有关。不过，优化部分存在一个前提：全部硬性安全与可行性约束必须通过。研究团队将其称为硬约束门控（Hard-Constraint Gating）。这个机制有一处关键设计。即使某个方案能够显著降低材料费用，只要违反了一项硬约束，就无法获得成本优化部分的分数。系统仍然记录它已经完成的检查，但不会允许经济收益抵消工程缺陷。PLE 同时设置了合规但未经充分优化的基线方案，以及合规成本的下界。前者用于判断 Agent 是否产生了实际优化收益，后者则为成本改善提供衡量尺度。这样，模型既不能通过选用过量设备轻松满足规范，也无法靠牺牲可行性获得漂亮的成本数字。这种评分方式让一个长期存在的问题变得清晰：工程设计中的优化空间受到约束限制，并且约束之间往往存在联系。例如，在冷却系统设计中，管径决定水力阻力，水力阻力影响水泵工作点，而实际流量又决定换热能力。Agent 如果只根据材料成本缩小管径，后续可能需要更高扬程的水泵，原本节省的费用反而转移到设备和运行能耗上。工程上把所有约束同时成立的设计范围称为可行域。它包含连续变化的参数，也受到设备型号、标准尺寸等离散条件限制。模型每修改一个变量，其他参数能够选择的范围便可能发生变化。这给 Agent 带来一种与普通推理不同的要求。生成候选方案之后，还需要判断当前哪些条件已经接近允许边界，以及下一次修改会影响哪些约束。工程优化中，这些限制进一步调整空间的条件通常被称为活跃约束。PLE 没有直接为 Agent 提供可行域搜索算法，但硬约束门控让这种能力缺口可以被测量。91% 的单项约束满足比例说明，模型已经能够处理大部分局部要求，剩余困难集中在多个条件共同成立，以及满足条件后继续优化。而当设计从单次求解进入长时间、多轮修改时，问题还会继续扩大：此前满足的约束，未必在下一轮操作后仍然有效。02长流程能力正在变成状态一致性问题PLE 的任务环境没有将设计条件整理成一份完整说明。85 项任务累计包含 51

articles.title: Who May Overrule the Agent? Evidence-Gated Authority in LLM Review Institutions
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05390v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multi-agent language-model systems often add a reviewer to improve an upstream agent's decision. Yet a reviewer can both repair errors and replace decisions that were already correct. We study this as a problem of institutional jurisdiction: conditional on the same proposal, task information, model, and review output, when is the reviewer authorized to make its recommendation binding? We compare broad override authority with an evidence gate that permits replacement only after the reviewer produces a mechanically valid record of a binding-constraint violation and a compliant repair. Across two locally run open-weight models, 96 spatial-policy tasks, and a 96-task portfolio-transfer benchmark, the gate sharply reduces corruption of correct proposals while retaining most repairs of violations. The directions of this tradeoff are partly implied by the rule; its magnitude depends on reviewer transitions and upstream proposal states. A prospe

articles.title: Agent Harness Awareness: Turning Verified Telemetry into Operational Control for Tool-Using Agents
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05391v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Tool descriptions tell an agent what an action can do, but they do not necessarily reveal whether that action is healthy or suitable at the moment of use. Execution harnesses often possess this information through monitors, traces, and recent failures while the model choosing the next action does not. We call this gap operational blindness. We introduce Agent Harness Awareness, a trust-separated design in which the host supplies a small, fresh, verified state snapshot before a consequential action while retaining measurement, enforcement, evaluation, and final dispatch authority. We test its tools-and-network instance with ToolRoute, a controlled isolation benchmark that holds the task and candidate semantics constant and varies the operational information available to the model. In a 216-decision ablation across GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, and Gemini 3.7 Flash, verified tool-health state reduced mean observable policy regret by 96.9%

articles.title: Uncertainty-Aware Resource Orchestration for Agentic AI Systems
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05392v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems powered by large language models (LLMs) execute as autonomous multi-step pipelines that dynamically invoke tools, integrate observations into memory, and iterate until a task is resolved or a resource budget is exhausted. Unlike classical workflows with fixed graphs, the aggregate compute, bandwidth, and end-to-end latency demands of such pipelines are unknown at dispatch time: they emerge at runtime from intermediate observations and stochastic token sampling, yielding heavy-tailed, multi-modal random variables. This unpredictability forces infrastructure orchestrators into a dilemma: under-provisioning risks mid-execution throttling and deadline violations, while over-provisioning wastes scarce edge or cloud capacity. articles.title: Challenge-Aware Knowledge Recruitment with Meta-Agent Supervision for Medical Multi-Agent Reasoning
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05393v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models perform strongly on standard medical QA but degrade on harder reasoning tasks, where multi-agent debate often fails to beat strong single-model prompting. We argue that a key limitation is that existing systems select experts and retrieve knowledge from the question alone, rather than from gaps that emerge during reasoning. We propose challenge-aware adaptive recruitment: an external CHALLENGER inspects the evolving reasoning trace and identifies specific factual or expertise gaps. These signals trigger targeted knowledge retrieval or mid-discussion specialist recruitment. On the MEDAGENTSBENCH hard subset (862 questions across nine biomedical datasets), upfront retrieval provides little benefit, while challenge-aware in-between retrieval performs better; on a multi-specialist backbone it improves accuracy on 8 of 9 datasets and adds 6 percentage points over Challenger Only. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05394v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Tiered inference distributes large language model computation across a hierarchy of devices, from on-device and edge hardware to the datacenter, and is increasingly offered as the route to cheaper, lower-latency, and more private serving. Most such systems orchestrate frozen model checkpoints, and most decide what to resolve locally and what to escalate using a confidence signal produced by a forward-deployed model. We give a closed-form condition for when no threshold on that signal makes a tiered cascade worthwhile relative to sending every query to the backstop. Modeling the routing decision as a binary test and separating local from escalation cost through an architecture cost ratio $\kappa$, we derive a feasibility condition bracketed by a signal-free floor, below which a cascade is feasible at any signal quality, and a perfect-signal ceiling, above which none is. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05450v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As agents become more capable, they are moving beyond one-off tasks toward sustained assistance across successive user goals. Such assistance requires agents to discover how unfamiliar environments work, reuse what they learn across tasks, and keep that experience current as environments evolve. Existing benchmarks increasingly study experience reuse and adaptation, but provide limited insight into which parts of accumulated experience agents revise, retain, or lose. To address this gap, we introduce ReScopeBench, a benchmark for the experience lifecycle across 18 interactive environments. It distinguishes structural experience about how an environment is organized and accessed from rule experience about reusable principles and constraints that guide decisions across tasks. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05459v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support scientific literature reviews, yet evaluations often examine individual tasks rather than the review process as a whole. We assess six AI tools across four stages: finding relevant articles, interpreting them, synthesizing across them, and proposing future research. The benchmark is a published review of the Spanish plume weather pattern and its 102-article corpus.
  In the initial searches, five tools collectively identified 57 articles, with the best individual tool finding 42. Institutional library access increased discovery from 42 to 82 articles for Codex and from 15 to 79 for Claude Code. Given the complete corpus of 102 PDFs, three tools correctly identified all 18 articles discussing the Spanish plume substantially, but incorrectly classified 40% to 79% of the 84 passing mentions as substantial. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05512v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: AI Agents are becoming digital coworkers that can browse the web, write code, run experiments, and assist humans over extended horizons. Yet existing benchmarks fall short of real knowledge work: many rely on synthetic data or isolated tasks, missing the complex, multi-party dynamics of collaborative projects, where critical information is scattered across conversations, code, and evolving decisions. Even simple workplace questions may require locating relevant channels and direct messages, recovering context from long discussions, inspecting repository state, reconciling stale or conflicting evidence, and synthesizing across sources.

articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05524v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We propose MA-SafeDiffuser, a multi-agent extension of SafeDiffuser that equips diffusion-based trajectory planners with finite-time diffusion invariance guarantees for joint-agent safety specifications. Building on the single-agent construction that embeds control barrier function (CBF) constraints into reverse-diffusion updates, we: (i) formalize joint safe sets as intersections of per-agent and pairwise barrier sets; (ii) derive centralized and decentralized (communication-aware) constrained denoising procedures with provable invariance under mild assumptions; (iii) address local-trap and deadlock phenomena via time-varying specifications and liveness CBFs; and (iv) develop a lightweight benchmarking suite including a multi-agent Maze2D domain. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05542v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Whole-page ranking jointly optimizes advertisements and organic content to balance business outcomes and user engagement under complex layout and business constraints. Existing non-autoregressive (NAR) approaches enable efficient page generation but typically score candidate items independently of previously selected items, limiting their ability to capture order-dependent interactions. Autoregressive (AR) methods address this limitation through sequential conditioning, but incur substantial inference overhead that challenges large-scale deployment. Bridging this quality-efficiency gap remains a challenge in industrial whole-page ranking.
  We propose Multi-Item Scoring (MIS), a prefix-aware NAR-style framework that incorporates sequential context into efficient multi-item scoring. articles.title: Iterated creation, grading, and revision of data science projects by language models
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05548v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We evaluate the extent to which agentic AI models can complete an end-to-end data science project, and how this improves with feedback. A 'writer' model with specific tools creates a complete data science project including downloading, cleaning, and analyzing a dataset, and writing a short paper about it. The project is executed and a 'grader' model evaluates it. The writer can then revise its submission, and this repeats for a total of three rounds. We consider seven models from five developers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, and Z.AI. Each model is both a writer and a grader, so there are 49 writer-grader pairs and we run each pair three times. Of the 147 initial submissions, 107 run and render, and the average score increases from 59 per cent to 76 per cent after the final round of feedback. articles.title: Whose Transparency is it Anyway? Understanding Generative AI Transparency Needs and Gaps Across Stakeholders
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05549v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Transparency has become a central principle in AI governance, yet there is little agreement about what transparency means, for whom, and in what contexts. Drawing on interpretive flexibility within the Social Construction of Technology, this paper examines how different stakeholders understand and experience transparency in generative AI. This study draws from a global survey of 400 end-users, AI builders, and policymakers, complemented by a structured focus group with end-users, grounding the quantitative findings in qualitative insights from the group most underserved by current transparency practice. We present three key findings. First, all three groups share similar understandings of what transparency means and what it should afford, centered on ensuring accuracy and privacy. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05551v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Virtual trials use routinely collected clinical data to evaluate treatment strategies, but translating a study protocol into an executable analysis requires determining how clinical concepts and study requirements should be represented in the available data and applied consistently across the workflow. articles.title: AGORA: Reliability-Aware Aggregation of LLM Judges via Item-Response Theory
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05556v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge is a common substitute for costly human evaluation, and aggregating several judges is the standard remedy for any single judge's bias. Judge pools mix judges of very different reliability, while the human-labeled sets that validate them hold a few hundred items or fewer. In this regime the per-item mean weights weak judges as heavily as strong ones, and confusion-table models such as Dawid-Skene must estimate a per-judge error table from too few items. We propose AGORA (Aggregation Of Reliability-weighted Assessments), an item-response-theory aggregator that places every item on one latent quality scale and describes each judge by a sensitivity parameter and ordered rating thresholds, so judge reliability is learned from all items jointly and without human labels. Across three benchmarks, AGORA matches or exceeds Dawid-Skene on large evaluation sets, and its advantage widens as the set shrinks toward a few hundred items. I

articles.title: BrainBind: Bridging Synchronized EEG and fMRI through Long-Form Naturalistic Video Representations
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05581v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Real-world vision is dynamic and scene-rich, while EEG and fMRI resolve it at complementary temporal and spatial scales. Most neural decoding systems, however, align one modality in isolation and mostly against static images or short clips. We study the synchronized case: EEG and fMRI are recorded during the same long-form naturalistic viewing, giving a shared stimulus but also recurring narrative context and many semantically similar candidates. We present BrainBind, a framework that maps synchronized EEG and fMRI into frozen long-form video embedding spaces and treats those spaces as common visual-semantic references, not literal neural codes. On CineBrain, a five-seed Recall@K 2 x 4 matrix across two video anchors and four system configurations shows distinct retrieval profiles. articles.title: Anduin: A sybil-resistant agentic marketplace reputation system
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05586v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As autonomous AI agents enter permissionless onchain markets, selecting new service providers remains a core challenge. Existing reputation systems depend on scarce resources like human curation, identity credentials, or voluntary reviews, while naive volume rankings are vulnerable to Sybil attacks.
  We evaluate whether existing onchain payment histories can yield provider ratings that are resilient against Sybil attacks. Using a 157-day dataset comprising 66M agentic transactions worth $6.1M across 16 blockchains, we model payment flows as a bipartite graph between buyers and providers. A provider's rating is derived from graph paths linked to a buyer's existing trusted network. articles.title: Hybrid Spark: Adaptive Speculative Decoding That Lets the Content Choose the Drafter
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05611v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) speeds up large language model (LLM) serving, but its gain depends on the workload's \emph{shape}, such as batch size and context length, and on its \emph{content}. A model-based drafter proposes a short block on any content, while a model-free drafter such as n-gram lookup proposes long copies at almost no cost when the output repeats its input, as in code editing. Adaptive verification spends a batch-wide verification budget on the draft tokens most likely to be accepted, but it supports only one model-based drafter. Model-free drafters provide no per-token confidence, so they cannot take part in budget allocation, and deployments must either fix one drafter or split their GPUs between drafters. articles.title: ViBench 2.0: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Software Building
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05620v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: On Replit, our agentic engineering platform, users now build entire products without writing code, through successive feature requests to an agent. Yet existing coding benchmarks evaluate single, fully specified tasks, and many are near saturation. We introduce ViBench 2.0, a benchmark for long-horizon software building that we use to select our platform's models. Its 17 full-stack web products, modeled on widely used software, grow over 241 feature requests and are judged only when finished, as a user would judge them: a browser agent runs 544 test plans, and a build passes only if every plan does, under a grading protocol validated to keep this strict score reliable. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05632v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Autonomous software agents can act through tools, delegate work, and change their models or execution environments while earlier authorizations remain in flight. We present Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization (ACCA), an approach designed to be harness-independent, for maintaining operational authority according to currently justified assurance. It distinguishes evidence validity from contextual applicability, derives assurance claims from eligible evidence, and resolves a multidimensional effective-authority envelope within a principal-declared ceiling and applicable policy. A typed dependency graph supports selective re-evaluation of authorization-relevant changes. An authority epoch changes when effective authority changes; a distinct optional authorization-basis version supports revalidation of action-specific authorization conditions. articles.title: Constraint-Preserving Flow Matching for Spectral Graph Generation
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05436v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Spectral graph generation models graphs through the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of their Laplacians, providing a compact and continuous alternative to direct graph construction. However, these eigensystems must retain the structural properties of graph Laplacians. Existing approaches preserve eigenvector orthonormality but do not enforce the Laplacian nullspace constraint, potentially producing eigensystems inconsistent with Laplacian structure. To address this, we introduce Laplacian-Constrained Stiefel Flow Matching (LaSFM), which preserves the nullspace condition alongside eigenvector orthonormality and positive eigenvalues during generation. We characterize the underlying constrained Stiefel manifold and formulate flow matching on it. We further extend LaSFM to property-guided generation, steering samples toward desired graph properties while maintaining these constraints. articles.title: Learning Implicit Solves for Dynamic Simulations
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05439v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: High-fidelity simulation of dynamical systems is central to scientific discovery and engineering design, yet remains computationally demanding. Here we introduce the Implicit Neural Operator Solver (INOS), which learns the implicit solve and encodes a time integrator. INOS pretrains a neural operator from static equilibrium solutions and reuses it within Newmark-$\beta$ integration. At each time increment, the integrator forms an effective equilibrium problem, the pretrained neural operator infers the next-step solution field, and the Newmark relations advance the dynamic state. Numerical examples in linear and nonlinear elastodynamics demonstrate accurate full-field predictions without dynamic trajectory supervision. Comparative results show that INOS, evaluated zero-shot, achieves higher predictive accuracy than neural solver baselines trained on dynamic simulations. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05442v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Background: Quantum machine learning (QML) is promoted for clinical prediction, but comparisons with classical models are rarely paired or tested for equivalence. Methods: We compared a quantum-kernel support vector machine (QSVM; 4 qubits, tuned bandwidth) and a variational quantum classifier (VQC) with five tuned classical models across six public clinical datasets. All models used identical four-component inputs and 25 cross-validation splits. Paired AUROC differences were assessed using a corrected resampled t-test, Holm-adjusted equivalence tests (margins: +/-0.02 and +/-0.05), and random-effects pooling. Ablation, noise, finite-shot, and implementation-fault analyses were conducted. We propose QML-Health-READY, an eight-domain reporting framework. articles.title: Objective-Conditioned Active Preference Learning for Multi-Objective Alignment
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05506v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with several objectives, such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty, typically relies on preference judgment for each objective, growing the annotation cost linearly with the number of objectives. Active preference learning can reduce this cost by selecting the comparisons whose labels are expected to change the policy most. Existing remedies either lack an objective-aware query selection mechanism for the multi-objective setting or regard conflicting preferences as harmful, therefore excluding them from the training data. We introduce OGC-DPO (Objective-conditioned Gradient Coverage DPO), an active learning framework that treats each (response pair, objective) combination as a separate query and measures its informativeness through the policy's own implicit gradient, without relying on an external reward model. OGC-DPO then selects the queries that most expand each objective's gradient coverage.

articles.title: The Confidence Score: a New Measure on Kernels
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05528v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Across a wide range of applications, kernel measures are used to tune hyperparameters, select among candidate kernels, and assess the suitability of kernels for specific learning tasks. For classification, kernel measures are used to predict which kernels may produce accurate kernel classifiers. Many existing kernel measures, such as alignment to the ideal kernel, are designed to reward kernels which captures all samples from the same class as similar. While effective in many settings, this requirement is unnecessarily restrictive for classification, where classes may exhibit substantial internal structure. In this work, the "Confidence Score", a new kernel measure, is proposed. Unlike alignment-to-the-ideal kernel measures, the Confidence Score measures the alignment between an encoding of the ground truth and that ground truth projected by the kernel, allowing kernels that preserve intra-class structure to achieve high scores. articles.title: FedSharp: Byzantine Robust Decentralized Federated Learning Under Noisy Channel
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05546v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) eliminates the central aggregation server but remains vulnerable to data heterogeneity, Byzantine attacks, and channel noise. We show that noise accumulates as models propagate across nodes, becoming increasingly significant as the learning rate decays. Moreover, accumulated noise enables Byzantine attackers to exploit loss-based model selection by mimicking honest model averages. To address these challenges, we propose screened, hop-aware, ranked, proximal averaging, a robust DFL framework (FedSharp). In this approach, each node maintains models from its 2b predecessors, ensuring at least b honest candidates when at most b nodes are Byzantine. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05557v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Support vector machines (SVMs) are fundamentally grounded in geometric margin maximisation and currently lack a mainstream probabilistic interpretation. This keeps them theoretically isolated from probabilistic machine learning models that are naturally comparable and combinable. In this paper, we bridge this gap by proving that the dual objectives of both support vector classification and support vector regression are exact, constrained Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence minimisation tasks between two Gaussian measures. We further show that this same divergence formulation recovers the exact objective function for kernel ridge regression when domain constraints are removed and $L^2$ regularisation is applied. Abstract: Data tends to be most useful when it is shared, and the data most worth sharing is often the data that privacy obligations restrict. Synthetic data from a generator trained under differential privacy (DP) is one way to reconcile the two, but its utility depends on the privacy budget $\varepsilon$ and on how much data the generator sees - a parameter that most data sharing applications of synthetic data control. We present SAVANT, a self-attentive variational autoencoder for tabular data trained with DP-SGD that, to our knowledge, is the first to combine attention, a VAE, and DP in one tabular model. We evaluate it against two marginal mechanisms, PrivBayes and MST, jointly over the privacy budget and the dataset size on two public datasets, measuring the utility a downstream classifier loses by training on synthetic rather than real data. Abstract: Reasoning-oriented language model training increasingly relies on multiple on-policy rollouts, but standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) uses a fixed group size, wasting compute on easy prompts and under-exploring hard ones. Existing adaptive-budget methods alleviate this inefficiency, yet their stopping rules are heuristic and do not provide a finite-sample calibration guarantee. Abstract: Relevance propagation, which redistributes a network's prediction backward through the layers, is usually treated as a heuristic. We show that it is the solution of a single variational problem: Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) is the divergence-free flow on the active computational graph of zero relative entropy to the backward transition law of the forward activation flow; for a non-negative reference, this is a relative entropy between Markov measures on backward paths. Abstract: A deep RL agent trained on a fixed persona reward plays one way: an Explorer keeps exploring while starving, a Survivor hoards on an empty map. Since each persona fixes its own reward, automated playtesting trains N agents for N styles. Abstract: Variational approaches to learning transport maps for multimodal sampling can suffer from mode collapse. One way to mitigate this problem is to learn transport along a prescribed path of intermediate distributions defined by geometric annealing. We show that annealing can take a substantial detour in Wasserstein space: when mass moves between modes, the path can be much longer than the distance between its endpoints. Motivated by these findings, we propose componentwise annealed transport (CAT) to reduce the need for mass transfer between modes. Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) to consolidate capabilities from multiple teachers. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05616v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Training on large datasets motivates selecting which examples receive expensive training computation. Fixed quotas determine the amount of pruning in advance, while absolute confidence cutoffs depend on the score scale. We study a population-relative alternative that adapts the threshold and retained count together. We introduce LACS (Label-Agnostic Confidence Selector), a training-time rule based on maximum predictive confidence, requiring neither labels at selection time nor per-example gradients. LACS removes examples at or above a log-mean-exp reference plus a margin. We characterize its sensitivity to score gaps and mass, and derive an exact no-pruning condition. For $0<\rho<1$, the removed fraction is at most $\rho$ and at least one example remains. The unsigned score permits both confidently correct and confidently wrong examples to be removed. Abstract: Large-scale ranking and recommendation models of Web platforms benefit from increased compute much as large language models do, and their scaling behavior is broadly power-law in form. Abstract: A central challenge in assistive brain-to-robot control is decoding a user's latent intent from complex and noisy brain signals. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05382v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Misinformation spreads faster than professional fact-checkers can manually verify it and write articles explaining their verdicts. This creates a need to automate the production of fact-checking articles. This paper details work done by the DS@GT ARC team for CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3 Fact-Checking Article Generation. We seek to generate a full fact-checking article from a claim, its original verdict, and a set of scraped source documents. Our team built a four-stage pipeline that cleans noisy evidence, retrieves and clusters relevant sources, generates the article by conditioning \texttt{Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct} on the original fact-checker verdict, and recovers inline citations through deterministic post-processing. We achieved a mean score of 0.428 and ranked 3rd out of 9 teams for the CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3, compared to a baseline mean score of 0.272. Abstract: LLMs can repair noisy OCR transcripts of historical documents, but they also change text that was already correct. We propose EditVeto, a veto gate placed after a full-context LLM rewrite. articles.title: RAGCompass: Generalizable Retriever Routing via Reranking
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05596v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Different retrievers exist for retrieval-augmented generation, yet none performs best for all queries. Therefore, the key question is: given a query and retrieved passages from different retrievers, which one is most suited for that query? Existing routers usually make predictions from query-specific features and a fixed pool of retrievers; such routers have no output for an unseen retriever and are incapable by design on a new corpus. To fill these gaps, RAGCompass reads the retrieved passage sets themselves: passages from an unfamiliar retriever or corpus stay directly comparable to other passages, so routing stays well designed where a query-only map would fail. Abstract: Speech transcription errors can be difficult to recognize when competing word hypotheses are unfamiliar or visually similar. We describe an interface that combines alternative transcripts, replay and contextually checked pictograms for selected uncertain concepts. The system will initially support French and Spanish functional utterances. A counterbalanced study will assess whether pictorial feedback helps listeners recover the speaker's intended action beyond text alternatives alone. We will also quantify semantic mismatch and additional interaction time, since an inappropriate image can reinforce the wrong interpretation rather than repair it.

Abstract: Search can help LLM agents correct mistakes, but their starting conditions may shape which evidence they find and use. Drawing on cognitive-bias paradigms, we develop a controlled search harness to examine result order, records of prior work, and initial hypotheses while holding each question and document collection fixed. Matched controls distinguish order effects from differences in document composition and the effects of failed work from context length. Across 10 models and 1,000 synthetic search worlds, we track queries, retrieved documents, document openings, and final answers. Our comparisons suggest that final answers are more sensitive to initial evidence order during active search than when all evidence is supplied in full. articles.title: Prospective Memory for Proactive LLM Agents
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05731v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Most memory systems for LLM agents are retrospective, preserving and retrieving past information to inform current decisions. Proactive agents, however, also require prospective memory: retaining future-directed intentions and realizing them when appropriate opportunities arise, even without explicit requests. Crucially, remembering the right intention does not guarantee acting at the right time: a related observation may call for waiting, while a later cue may make the same intention actionable. Inspired by cognitive theories of human prospective memory, we introduce Pro-Memory, a memory framework that separates maintaining future intentions from deciding when and how to realize them. Pro-Memory preserves pending objectives linked to their supporting evidence, assesses new observations against their original goals and activation conditions, and coordinates appropriate contributions with the agent's ongoing actions. Abstract: This study investigates the authorship impersonation capacity of six widely used large language models (LLMs): Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Opus, GPT 5.2, GPT 5.2 Pro, DeepSeek 3.2, and Grok 4.1 Fast. The evaluation was conducted using short product review texts selected to ensure high within author consistency in individual writing style. Two types of in context prompt were designed: a simple prompt with minimal instruction and a complex prompt incorporating explicit stylometric guidance for mimicry. Authorship mimicry was evaluated using a cosine distance based distance to training metric, supplemented by visual analyses of embedding distributions. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05803v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: How much phonological knowledge do language models (LMs) possess about Chinese characters, and how is this knowledge represented and used? We introduce PinyinBench, a controlled benchmark covering homophones, phonological features (initials, finals, and tones), and polyphonic characters. We investigate 17 text-only and multimodal LMs through three complementary approaches: behavioral evaluation, layer-wise probing, and activation steering. Behaviorally, models demonstrate substantial knowledge of initials and finals, with a frontier model (DS-v4-flash) scoring 90%+ in homophone judgment, when two characters share no phonological features. However, its accuracy drops sharply to 72% when two characters differ only in lexical tone. Abstract: Large language models increasingly automate complex tasks, but human decision capacity does not scale with their capabilities. In many applications, humans remain essential for providing private context, authority, or judgments unavailable to the agent. We formulate human decision capacity allocation: given multiple consultation opportunities and a limited budget, at which decisions should an LLM agent consult a human? The central challenge is estimating consultation value, which is executor-dependent because the same human input may benefit different downstream agents differently. We introduce Consultation Value Distillation (CVD), which estimates consultation values offline using Monte Carlo executor rollouts and distills these values into lightweight predictors for budgeted allocation, requiring no rollout-based value estimation at deployment. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05827v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Decision models choose among predefined options in tasks such as routing and action selection. In multi-agent collaboration, a decision determines how members divide work, exchange resources, and act in parallel. We introduce TandemBench, a benchmark of 1,200 questions in multi-agent cooking scenarios where coordination choices affect goal completion. Models receive complete global information and candidate team plans, with reference answers established through execution and exact search. Models select an optimal team plan and, in paired variants that retain or remove it, judge whether better arrangements exist beyond the supplied options. We evaluate 40 native decision models and compare them with 10 general-purpose language models. The best native decision model achieves 62.50% decision accuracy. Abstract: Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations. However, reliable evaluation faces Data scarcity and Difficulty Standardizing Criteria. To address these obstacles, we introduce CARTBench for CART (Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines). For Difficulty Standardizing Criteria, we develop case-specific rubrics guided by Ideal Response Principles, distilled from excellent replies manually selected from successfully completed orders. These principles also guide Principle-Guided CART Prompting, our structured recommendation strategy. Abstract: Confidence estimates guide human review in LLM-built knowledge graphs, but better error prediction can yield little improvement in an audit. articles.content:

Abstract: Visual autoregressive generation spans two dominant paradigms: next-scale prediction for images and video, and next-frame prediction for video. Both decode block-by-block rather than token-by-token, yielding KV caches whose statistics diverge from those of language models. At scale, KV memory exceeds the weights and limits large-scale deployment caused by a large amount of visual tokens. Our analysis of these caches reveals three findings. First, a small set of massive-value channels carries the functional load: ablating these outlier channels collapses generation, whereas ablating a matched set of inlier channels leaves quality intact. Second, the outliers organize along two axes, feature and block, with magnitudes persistent within each cell and shifting across cells. Abstract: In Bangladesh, much localized misinformation spreads as photocards: single-image news summaries that imitate the branding of well-known news organizations. Because the misleading message lives in the pixels rather than in machine-readable text, text-based fact-checking tools cannot see it. We recast photocard fake-news detection as visual image forgery detection. We build a dataset of 969 authentic and 1,077 fabricated Bangla photocards scraped from public Facebook pages: authentic cards from the verified pages of seventeen national television broadcasters, fabricated ones from pseudo-broadcaster pages, anonymous profiles, and public groups. Sixteen photometric and morphological transformations per image grow the corpus to 32,736 samples. articles.content:

Abstract: The hand localization problem has been a longstanding focus due to its many applications. The task involves modeling the hand as a singular point and determining its position within a defined coordinate system. However, due to data modality limitations, existing hand localization technologies face several challenges. For example, vision-based localization raises privacy concerns, while wearable-based methods compromise user comfort. In this paper, we introduce mmHand, a new device-free, privacy-preserving dynamic hand localization system with pixel-level accuracy, using a single commodity mmWave device. We first propose a mmImage generation tool to fully extract spatial information from raw mmWave data and introduce a novel 2D image-format representation of mmWave data. Abstract: Contrastive pretraining has advanced image-text understanding, yet image, video, and audio encoders are still trained independently, with cross-modal alignment realized mainly through post-hoc binding to a frozen anchor space. We present Omni-Encoder, a general multimodal encoder that processes image, video, audio, and audio-visual inputs within a single SigLIP-2 Vision Transformer with fully shared parameters. Unlike anchor-centric binding or per-modality adapters, all modalities are optimized jointly end-to-end, and the framework is organized from input to training. A modality-native input stage first maps each signal into the shared embedding space, including a 1D-convolutional audio tokenizer that converts mel-spectrograms into tokens aligned with visual patches. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05407v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Diffusion image generators are successful due to accurate denoising networks and strong numerical samplers. Yet the two components are not fully matched. During sampling, the denoiser predicts for the next step based on flawed input that differ much from the real data. This train-test gap, or exposure bias, caps image generation quality (i.e., blurry, lacking in details or awkward in shape). To mitigate the problem, we propose PEEK, a novel training-free deterministic sampler plugin. At each eligible denoising step, PEEK first performs a provisional one-step update, evaluates the denoiser once at the look-ahead state, and interpolates it with the one-step-later prediction to form the next noisy state. By taking the additional step, we obtain a generally more-image-like prediction from the higher-signal noisy state, mitigating the exposure bias. Abstract: Low-textured sketch images are widely used in scientific applications, including wildlife conservation, archaeological illustration, and forensic composites. Learning from and retrieving such images is challenging because they lack detailed surface textures and visual variations commonly exploited by modern deep learning models. This paper proposes Augmentation with Reinforcement Transformation (ART) to fine-tune pretrained models to learn effective representations for accurate sketch image retrieval. Our key observation is that sketches are particularly sensitive to image transformations, such as rotation, flipping, zooming, and stretching. Abstract: Point cloud denoising aims to recover clean geometry from noisy 3D observations while preserving both fine surface details and the underlying spatial distribution of the points. Many learning-based methods adopt a two-stage pipeline that first extracts point-wise features from the noisy input and subsequently predicts point-wise displacements via simple regressions. However, these approaches often lack robust feature guidance and distribution-aware geometric refinement, causing them to fail at maintaining optimal point uniformity and geometric quality. To address these limitations, we propose PointNDF, a denoising framework that combines patch-level geometric context with local displacement prediction. Abstract: Surgical world models have the potential to provide intra-operative guidance, accelerate risk-free training and facilitate transfer of expert surgical maneuvers. However, the use of world models for transferring surgical expertise has been largely unexplored. Moreover, recent approaches in this domain have mainly relied on ground truth kinematics actions or expert annotations for specific tasks, limiting their applicability beyond the narrow range of tasks with ground-truth annotations. In contrast, existing works in the natural domain have shown promising results in learning latent actions solely from unlabeled videos and transferring the learned actions across contexts. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05449v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Learning on boundary representations (B-reps) requires robustness to the pose of a part, since CAD models are not stored in a canonical orientation. Existing B-rep networks either operate on world-frame coordinates and normals, and thus degrade under rotation, or encode each face in a local reference frame. Local frames yield invariance, but reduce inter-face messages to scalars and discard the relative orientation of adjacent faces. We propose SO3brep, an SO(3)-equivariant graph neural network on the B-rep face-adjacency graph. Node features are computed in local frames and mapped into a shared frame by Wigner D-matrices. Clebsch-Gordan tensor products couple these features with the directions between adjacent faces, so that relative orientation is preserved throughout message passing and the output remains SE(3)-invariant. articles.title: From Tokens to Trajectories: Parameter-Efficient Continuous Adaptation of Unified Multimodal Models
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05451v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: While discrete tokenization in Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) establishes strong semantic reasoning, it introduces a strict quantization bottleneck that degrades fine-grained visual details, often resulting in structurally accurate but artifact-heavy images. We introduce FlowShift, a parameter-efficient post-training framework that bypasses this bottleneck by converting pre-trained discrete UMMs into continuous rectified-flow generators. Instead of discarding the backbone's semantic priors, FlowShift replaces discrete visual interfaces with continuous latent projections and applies LoRA to the attention layers. To efficiently boost visual quality without semantic drift, we propose Dual-Objective Velocity Vector Distillation (DOVD), which aligns the model with a high-fidelity continuous teacher and ground-truth continuous trajectories. This approach drastically improves perceptual quality while preserving prompt adherence and reasoning.

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose visual representations into individual features, offering a promising basis for explaining model behavior. By intervening on representations along SAE decoder directions and reconstructing the visual output, we provide direct evidence of a feature's semantic meaning. Abstract: In biodiversity monitoring, a single image raises several questions: which taxon, how many, which trait, and whether the individual has been seen before. Vision-language models (VLMs) could answer all of these from the image, but their ability is largely untested in biology, as existing benchmarks focus mostly on species identification within a few taxonomic groups. We present Bio-VQA, the largest biological visual question answering (VQA) benchmark and the only one to span four aspects of biological visual understanding: hierarchical taxonomic reasoning, fine-grained attribute grounding, quantitative spatial reasoning, and individual re-identification. Bio-VQA contains 1.86M questions over 217K images from 11 public datasets, and extends right-or-wrong scoring to graded scoring, so a near-miss counts for more than a distant one. articles.title: ChangeJEPA: Predict Before You Compare for Remote Sensing Change Detection
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05570v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Remote sensing change detection is typically formulated as Siamese feature comparison, where two images are encoded independently and a decoder determines which discrepancies correspond to meaningful change. This is challenging because the encoders preserve both true scene changes and nuisance variations such as illumination, seasonal, radiometric, and geometric differences. We introduce ChangeJEPA, a bitemporal joint-embedding predictive architecture that reformulates change detection as latent post-state prediction. Given a pre-change image and partial post-change evidence, ChangeJEPA predicts the full post-change representation under two complementary conditions: a prior hypothesis derived from the pre-change scene and an updated hypothesis conditioned on observed post-change context. articles.title: Whose Values Are Generated? Measuring Visual Value Leakage in Multilingual Text-to-Image Generation
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05578v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) systems serve users across languages and cultural contexts. However, evaluations of cultural representation focus mainly on recognizable elements such as landmarks, clothing, and activities, overlooking the cultural values that generated images convey. To bridge this gap, we introduce VisionValueBench, a multilingual benchmark that operationalizes six of Hofstede's cultural value dimensions (e.g., individualism versus collectivism) to investigate how T2I systems frame neutral social situations through a particular cultural orientation. We find that value-neutral prompts, which admit diverse cultural interpretations, nonetheless yield images that favor particular value orientations, a phenomenon we call visual value leakage. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05579v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal AI fusion of histology and clinical data is an active research area in computational pathology, but fusion methods are rarely compared under identical conditions and across different clinical endpoints. We present a modular framework in which slide-level embeddings, obtained by training an attention-based aggregator over patch embeddings from a frozen foundation model, and per-visit clinical embeddings are fed into 15 interchangeable fusion methods with a shared output dimension and prediction head (except decision-level methods). Using a prospective cohort of newly diagnosed inflammatory bowel disease patients, we predicted STRIDE-II-aligned remission outcomes from baseline or follow-up visits. articles.title: GaussianRenderFormer: Transformer-based Rendering of 3D Gaussian Splats
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05593v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Can a neural network learn to render 3D Gaussian splats on its own, with no rasterizer in the renderer? We present GaussianRenderFormer, a transformer that takes a set of Gaussians and a camera and outputs the image directly. Each Gaussian becomes one token in a view-independent encoder, and a view-dependent decoder turns small patches of camera rays into pixels by attending to those tokens. Trained on 26,820 Objaverse objects pruned to 20,000 Gaussians each, GaussianRenderFormer renders 300 unseen objects at 38.08 dB PSNR against the full, unpruned splats, while rasterizing the same pruned input reaches 44.02 dB. The gap is not one of generalization, and our diagnostics are consistent with a bottleneck in the view decoder: telling it the projected footprint of each Gaussian, which it could in principle infer, adds 1.4 dB. Under-training is not ruled out. Code, trained models and videos: https://svlwoof.github.io/gaussianrenderformer

articles.title: CAPTOR: text-encoder-free grounding by counting caption co-occurrence over the visual words of a frozen encoder
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05599v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Grounding a text query in an image needs a matrix scoring every term against every patch. Vision-language models compute it with an aligned text encoder, which many image encoders, such as histopathology-related models trained on slides alone, lack. The Caption-Anchored Patch-Term Occurrence Representation (CAPTOR) estimates the matrix without a text encoder. It clusters a frozen image encoder's patch tokens into visual words and describes each captioned image by its share of patches in each word. A term signature is the standardized difference of those shares between images whose captions mention the term and the rest. The matrix factorizes into a term-by-word table and a query-independent image factor, so an image is encoded once and a new term adds one table row. articles.title: Jev with Foresight: Safe Language-Guided Autonomous Driving via a Language World Model
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05448v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models understand passengers' driving commands, but as driving agents they reason in generated text for seconds and must infer each action's consequences implicitly from the scene. We present Jev-AD, which pairs Jev, a typed decision model that answers predefined questions with probabilities, not generated text, with a language world model that predicts for every candidate action how nearby vehicles move over the next two seconds. Code turns these predictions into foreseen consequences, which Jev compares instead of inferring them from coordinates. In simulated highway merging (500 car-episodes), this foresight lowers the same decision model's collision rate from 26.0% to 2.4% at 0.25 seconds per decision, and Jev-AD achieves the passenger's intent in 93% of free-form command trials. articles.title: Ctrl-F: Force as an Interface for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05507v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Humanoid motion tracking has scaled to general policies that reproduce diverse human motion, but the resulting behavior is in free-space: the tracker knows where the body should be, not how it should interact with the environment. Other work makes the object part of the objective, yet abstracts that interaction to contact or geometry, which leaves the demanding cases under-explored. We argue that force is a natural command channel between motion imitation and object interaction, one that specifies not just where to make contact but how hard. We present Ctrl-F, a hierarchical motion-force framework that augments motion tracking with an explicit force command, a 3-D force at each designated contact body such as a hand or a foot. The hierarchical framework comprises: (1) A unified motion-force controller tracks the reference motion while applying the commanded force to the world. articles.title: MESA: An Evaluation Framework for Compositional, Semantic, and Spatial Generalization in Robotics
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05567v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Despite growing interest in foundation models for robotic manipulation, systematic evaluation of their capabilities remains elusive. Existing benchmarks are either narrow and saturated, offering little signal on SOTA methods, broadly scoped, providing diversity at the cost of controlled experimentation, or require training on large, messy open-source datasets. We introduce MESA, an evaluation framework designed for precise, reproducible measurement of language-conditioned policy generalization. MESA provides five evaluation suites that isolate in-distribution performance and four distinct axes of generalization: spatial configuration, object instance, object category, and subtask composition, enabling researchers to diagnose where and why policies fail, not just whether they fail. articles.title: ELA: End-to-End Latent Action Policy Learning from Video Demonstrations
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05571v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Robot imitation learning is limited by the scarcity of action-labeled data, while action-free demonstrations such as videos are abundant. Recent latent-action methods learn action-relevant representations from observation transitions, but they do not optimize latent actions for downstream control, leading to latent representations that are difficult for policies to model and difficult to accurately decode into continuous robot actions. This paper introduces ELA, an end-to-end framework for learning from video demonstrations via latent actions jointly optimized for policy learning and action decoding. ELA jointly trains a latent action model, latent action policy, and action decoder, enabling policies to leverage abundant video data with only a handful of action-labeled robot demonstrations. articles.title: Contact-Implicit Whole-Body Trajectory Optimization for Dynamic Humanoid Locomotion on Parameterizable Uneven Terrain
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05585v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This letter presents a trajectory planner for humanoid robots to perform dynamic motions on complex, parameterizable terrains using a contact-implicit whole-body optimization framework. The planner generates feasible movements without predefined contact sequences, considering the robot's full dynamics and kinematics. To plan bipedal locomotion on steps, ramps, and other terrains, we propose a mathematical model to approximate ground geometry with a smooth surface. The rigid interaction between the robot and the ground is modeled via novel contact constraints, extending the domain of applicability from flat and horizontal surfaces to any arbitrary smooth surface. Effectiveness is demonstrated using nonlinear programming to plan motions on various terrain topologies. articles.title: $\mathcal{C}^\infty$ Smooth Trajectory Planning with Application to Soft Robots
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05615v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: High motion performance and avoiding structural vibrations rely on smooth trajectory planning. The smoothness requirement depends on the robot's complexity in terms of the number of degrees of freedom and system order due to the flexibility of the joints and links. For industrial robots, the smoothness requirements have been determined and subsequently taken into account. Although unknown for soft continuum robots, the exact smoothness requirement can potentially be much larger than previously considered ones such as $\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^4}$ for collaborative robots and $\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^5}$ for quadcopter drones. To address this gap, we introduce a $\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^\infty}$-smooth trajectory generator that respects defined kinematic limits and generates infinitely differentiable trajectories. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05667v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This paper presents Proactive Human-in-the-Loop (PHIL), a framework for proactive policy correction and preference-based post-training. PHIL enables operators to preview policy-predicted future motion and intervene before anticipated undesirable actions. During takeover, PHIL continues querying the policy and displaying its predicted trajectories in the physical workspace through an extended reality (XR) interface. PHIL pairs rejected policy predictions with corrective action chunks subsequently executed from the same physical state over the same horizon, and preference-based post-training encourages the policy to favor these corrections. This paper evaluates PHIL on four real-world manipulation tasks using a diffusion policy and a pretrained vision-language-action policy. articles.title: OdorSpaces: Visual-Olfactory Embodied Navigation in 3D Environments
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05738v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Olfaction provides critical information about airborne chemical cues, yet it remains largely underexplored in embodied AI, with limited prior machine olfaction work focusing primarily on semantic odor perception. We introduce OdorSpaces, a physics-based simulation platform and benchmark for visual-olfactory embodied navigation. OdorSpaces augments Habitat-Sim with 3D odor transport and dispersion simulated by Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS), enabling agents to navigate photorealistic indoor environments using both visual and olfactory observations. The benchmark includes two representative source-seeking scenarios: invisible gas-leak localization and early-stage fire localization. We develop an initial multimodal reinforcement learning policy that integrates visual observations and olfactory measurements over time.
